headline: A 1-for-5 night
record_line: Yesterday: 1-4 on the top plays · Season: 35-140

entries.headline: Manny Machado stayed in the yard
entries.story: Manny Machado went 0-for-2 with 1 BB and 1 RBI against Nick Lodolo and the Cincinnati Reds. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Fernando Tatis Jr. connected at +255
entries.story: Fernando Tatis Jr. cashed. Facing Nick Lodolo, he went deep in the 5th in his 3rd at bat. The call: "Fernando Tatis Jr. homers (18) on a line drive to right field." He added another later in the game. Final line: 2-for-5.

entries.headline: Matt Olson came close
entries.story: Matt Olson went 1-for-4 against Jake Irvin and the Washington Nationals. Closest call was a double in the 8th: "Matt Olson hits a ground-rule double (33) on a line drive to center field." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Yordan Alvarez stayed in the yard
entries.story: Yordan Alvarez went 0-for-2 with 2 BB against Sean Burke and the Chicago White Sox. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.

entries.headline: Colson Montgomery came close
entries.story: Colson Montgomery went 2-for-4 with 1 BB and 2 RBI against Ronel Blanco and the Houston Astros. Closest call was a double in the 5th: "Colson Montgomery doubles (22) on a line drive to right fielder Cam Smith. Miguel Vargas scores. Andrew Benintendi scores." The power showed up; the carry did not.
